_help: Letters everyone receives. Each needs a unique id (never reuse one). rewards: tokens, gifts {sweets/tea/books/flowers: n}, character (id), skin (id). start/end are optional UTC times. Add "to": ["NT-XXXX-XXXX"] to send a letter only to those Player IDs (shown in Settings). This file is also read live from GitHub (remote_url). adjustments: silent per-player fixes, not shown in the mailbox, applied once per save when the home screen opens: {"id": "unique_id", "to": ["NT-XXXX-XXXX"], "tokens_max": 5000} lowers Memory Tokens to at most 5000; "tokens_remove": 1000 takes 1000 away. "to" is required.

mail.title: A present from Haru!
mail.body: Thanks for spending time at the academy! Here are some Memory Tokens, and you can invite any resident you like to your dorm. Choose carefully!
